entities.name: Inga Björk-Klevby

entities.summary: Inga Karin Margareta Björk Klevby, is the former United Nations Deputy Executive Director of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-HABITAT). She was appointed to this position by United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan in October 2005.
